paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 5.9, with a decrease of 4.53% from the prior close and 10.47% over the last 22 sessions.

Another article mentioned the departure of CEO Toby Neugebauer and the setup of an Interim Office of the CEO.

There have been several recent SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031.
